Summary: The drawing app froze and crashed due to running out of memory, caused by a large memory-hungry program.
likely_cause: SketchPad crashed because it ran out of memory while PhotoSync was using 8600 MB, exceeding available RAM.
Evidence: On Sat 8:27:11 AM, SketchPad crashed with 'System.OutOfMemoryException'.
Memory was at 94% at the time of crash, with PhotoSync using 8600 MB.
PhotoSync is an unknown program with no known relation to SketchPad.
No recent installs or updates were recorded.
Steps: Close all open programs, especially PhotoSync and browsers, before opening SketchPad.
Try opening SketchPad with only a few files to test if it works without memory pressure.
Check if PhotoSync is needed; if not, uninstall it to free up memory.
Restart the PC and open SketchPad to see if the issue repeats.
